$comment: Rules for scripts/build-vessel.mjs. 'rules' are matched in order against cubemain.txt 'description' (case-insensitive regex); the first match wins. A rule either hides the row, records a usage limit ('limit' key + 'times', from the '… max N trap' rows), or puts the row in a 'section' (optionally a 'group'; $1… come from the match). Each recipe appears as a pair of rows (souls > N and souls = N); they merge into one recipe that needs at least N souls. Mod wording comes from scripts/cube-rules.json so it matches the Cube Recipes page.
intro: Vessel of Souls is a special mythical unique amulet that consumes organs in the Horadric Cube to gain bonuses based on the organs used. It starts with {souls} souls, and every recipe consumes some of them.

There are four tiers of bonuses. Each tier must be completed before the next one opens (e.g. tier 3 recipes don't work until tiers 1 and 2 are done). Every tier holds 5 recipes, except tier 4, which works differently. The item shows a special orange text when a tier is exhausted.
Once all souls are used, the Vessel of Souls can be transformed into one of several mythical weapon bases, keeping every bonus applied.

Vessel of Souls is the only equippable unique item that can be anointed. It can't be corrupted while it has unconsumed souls, and it can't be worn as an amulet: it has to be transformed into a weapon first.

sections.intro: Each tier 3 recipe consumes {cost} souls per use.

sections.title: Tier 4
sections.intro: Tier 4 is special compared to the other tiers: recipes here have varying soul costs, and some need an exact number of souls left.

sections.title: Weapon Anointments
sections.intro: The tier 4 anointment recipe gives the Vessel one of these at random.

sections.title: Completion
sections.intro: After all souls are used, transform the Vessel of Souls into a mythical weapon base. It keeps every applied bonus, can be worn without restrictions, loses its flavor text and gains triple the usual tinkering points. It can't be transformed while an anointment is pending.
